_comment: Shared by apps/api buyingPower.test.ts and apps/web lib/__tests__/buyingPower.test.ts so the server check and the AVAILABLE display can't drift. Prices: BTC 50000, ETH 2500; SOL has no price.

cases.name: $50 long: cash spent, the long costs nothing more
$50 short: proceeds in, 2x the short out (same as the $50 long)
resting short sell counts 1x until it fills
resting TP sell against a long is not a short
resting sell larger than the long: only the excess counts
can go negative after a losing short
unpriced asset with no exposure is ignored
unpriced asset with a short makes buying power unknown
